T: Second star to the right. Snacks straight on.
D: A boy who never grows up takes Wendy and her brothers to Neverland to face Captain Hook.
P: Serve the snacks when the children fly over London.
S: Toasted baguette with smashed peas, mint, feta and lemon
Baguette slices toasted with olive oil, topped with smashed peas, mint and feta, the green ridges made with a fork.
Skull Rock gruyère and pepper puffs

Golden choux puffs loaded with gruyère and cracked black pepper, crisp outside and hollow inside, served warm from the oven. Boil 250ml water with 100g butter and a pinch of salt, tip in 150g plain flour and beat over the heat for 1 minute until it leaves the sides. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy. Stir in 120g grated gruyère and 1 tsp cracked pepper. Pipe 30 small balls onto lined trays, top with a little extra cheese and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.
Green prawns poached in lemon water, chilled in iced water, tails on
Prawns poached in salted water with lemon, chilled and served on ice with a cocktail sauce of mayo, tomato sauce and lemon.
M: Captain Hook's beef and allspice stew
Beef chuck stewed with onion, carrot, allspice and molasses

Beef chuck simmered for hours with onions, carrots, allspice and a touch of molasses until thick and dark, with crusty bread. Toss 1kg diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp plain flour and brown in batches. Soften 2 sliced onions and 3 chopped carrots, then add the beef, 1 tsp ground allspice, 1 tbsp molasses or brown sugar, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 750ml beef stock. Cover and simmer gently for 3 hours until thick and tender. Season well and serve in big bowls with crusty bread.
the Lost Boys' hideout under the tree

Sticky drumsticks roasted in honey, paprika and garlic, with buttered corn cobs and crispy roast potatoes, all eaten with your hands. Toss 12 chicken drumsticks with 3 tbsp honey, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tbsp oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes, turning once, until sticky and cooked through. Roast 1kg potato chunks tossed in oil alongside for 45 minutes. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes, cut in half and roll in butter. Pile everything onto one big board.
W: Buttered white bread covered in sprinkles, cut into triangles
White bread spread with butter and covered in hundreds and thousands, cut into triangles, dusted with a little edible glitter.
K: Warm milk whisked with malt powder, honey and vanilla

Warm milk whisked frothy with malt powder, honey and vanilla, topped with a cloud of cream and a dusting of nutmeg. Heat 1L milk in a saucepan until steaming but not boiling. Take off the heat and whisk in 4 tbsp malted milk powder, 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp vanilla until frothy. Pour into 4 mugs. Whip 100ml cream to soft peaks and spoon a little on each, then grate over a little nutmeg. Serve with a plain biscuit on the side.

dishes.make_ahead: Smash the peas up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; toast the baguette and spread just before serving

steps.text: Slice the baguette and brush with oil.
Toast the slices under the grill or in a hot oven until golden.
Cook the peas in boiling water until tender, then drain.
Smash the peas with the mint, crumbled feta, a squeeze of lemon and salt and pepper to taste.
Spread thickly on the toasts and run a fork along the top for crocodile ridges.
Bring a pot of water to the boil with the salt and the lemon slices.
Poach the prawns until pink.
Plunge into iced water to stop the cooking.
Peel the prawns, leaving the tails on.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, a squeeze of lemon and the hot sauce.
Serve the prawns on ice with the sauce.

veg.n: Mermaid lagoon asparagus and hearts of palm

steps.text: Bring a pot of water to the boil with the salt and slices of one lemon.
Poach the asparagus for 2 minutes until bright green.
Plunge into a bowl of water with half the ice to stop the cooking.
Drain the asparagus and halve the hearts of palm lengthways.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, a squeeze of the second lemon and the hot sauce.
Serve the asparagus and hearts of palm on the rest of the ice with the sauce.

dishes.n: Captain Hook's beef and allspice stew

steps.text: Toss the beef in the flour. Slice the onions and chop the carrots.
Brown the beef in batches in the olive oil in a heavy pot.
Soften the onions and carrots.
Return the beef and add the allspice, molasses, tomato paste and stock.
Cover and simmer gently until thick and tender.
Season well with salt and pepper and serve in big bowls with crusty bread.

veg.n: Captain Hook's mushroom and allspice stew

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms in the flour. Slice the onions, chop the carrots and cube the sweet potato.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil in a heavy pot.
Soften the onions and carrots.
Return the mushrooms and add the sweet potato, kidney beans, allspice, molasses, tomato paste and stock.
Cover and simmer gently until thick and the sweet potato is tender.
Season well with salt and pepper and serve in big bowls with crusty bread.

dishes.make_ahead: Make up to 3 hours ahead and cover with a damp tea towel; dust with the glitter at the last minute

steps.text: Butter the bread right to the edges.
Press each buttered side into a plate of hundreds and thousands until well covered.
Cut into triangles.
Dust with the edible glitter and pile on a plate.

dishes.make_ahead: Whip the cream up to 4 hours ahead, covered in the fridge; heat the milk just before serving

steps.text: Heat the milk in a saucepan until steaming but not boiling.
Off the heat, whisk in the malted milk powder, honey and vanilla until frothy.
Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Pour into mugs, spoon a little cream on each and grate over nutmeg. Serve with a plain biscuit.

s.note: Toasted baguette with smashed peas, mint, feta and lemon
s.how: Slice a baguette and brush with olive oil, then toast until golden. Cook 300g peas, then smash with chopped mint, crumbled feta and a squeeze of lemon. Spread thickly on the toasts and run a fork along the top to make green crocodile ridges.

s.note: Green prawns poached in lemon water, chilled in iced water, tails on
s.how: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil with lemon slices. Add 500g green prawns and poach for 2 minutes until pink, then plunge into iced water. Peel, leaving tails on, and serve on ice with a sauce of mayonnaise, tomato sauce, lemon and hot sauce.
